items.alt: Opal search results in a dark gallery: a featured Arrival card with a Save button, a Movies row of poster cards, and Music and Podcasts sections below.
items.caption: Poster grids like this fill faster: posters are downscaled to 512 px on a worker, kept in a memory cache, and most fetches reuse one pooled connection. Native UI capture with offline fixture art; no live provider is shown.
